name: KRIA Active Window Bridge
description: Window perception + control bridge for KRIA GUI Cognition. Read-only focused-window snapshot (GetActiveWindow, unauthenticated, back-compat) plus token-gated window enumeration, activation, and management (ListWindows/ActivateWindow/SetWindowState/MoveResizeWindow/MoveWindowToWorkspace/GetMonitors) over a bounded session D-Bus interface. Window-only; no input injection. GNOME Wayland + Xorg.
